duration.text: The Optical Engineering at Hebei University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3750 USD/per year ￥ 27000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Letter of Guarantee 7.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: Applicants should reach HSK level 8 in principle, but for professional research-based students, they can be taught in English. So it is not a must to hold a HSK certificate.
